hint.post: ...Do not make me do that again.

agency.name: The Agency
agency.intro: Detective Agency rounds: read the clue, order the events, find the statement that can't be true, and deduce with the right strength.

rounds.line: Enri is missing. Start with the café. Mia left this note on the counter.

doc.title: MIA'S NOTE
doc.html:
8:15 a.m.

I've already served breakfast, but I haven't seen the orange cat yet. His cushion is still warm.

— Mia

options: No, she hasn't seen him yet.
Yes, she saw him at breakfast.
Yes, she has just fed him.
rounds.retryLine: Read the note again. Look at 'yet'.
rounds.thanks: Good. Nobody has seen him since last night.

rounds.line: It was a normal morning. I opened the café at seven. I was cleaning the counter when I heard the back door. Then I saw the empty cushion.
rounds.retryLine: No, listen again. What came first?

rounds.line: Two statements about ten o'clock last night. They can't both be true.

statements.text: I was reading inside at ten.

rounds.evidence: Jack's umbrella, by the door. It is still wet. It stopped raining at half past ten.
rounds.retryLine: Look at the umbrella again. Who was in the rain?
rounds.thanks: Right. Jack was outside. He isn't lying: he forgot he went out for the newspaper.

rounds.line: Now the evidence board. How sure can we be?
rounds.evidence: There is orange hair on a delivery box. The box is big enough for a cat.
options: He might be in the box.
He must be in the box.
He can't be in the box.
rounds.retryLine: Careful. Hair on a box is a possibility, not proof.
rounds.thanks: Exactly. It's possible. We check the truck.

rounds.line: And this one.
rounds.evidence: The hotel's cameras show Vera in the lobby from nine until midnight.
options: It might be Vera.
It can't be Vera.
It must be Vera.
rounds.retryLine: She was on camera all night. So?

vault.name: The Vault
vault.intro: Vault rounds. One clock for the whole chamber: a wrong answer costs fifteen seconds. Every door gives you a digit. Enter all five at the keypad.

rounds.line: Door one. Passive voice required. Rewrite the sentence.
rounds.source: Someone locked the door at nine.
rounds.answer: The door was locked at nine
alts: The door was locked at nine by someone
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. The door is the subject.

rounds.line: Identity check. Describe the power use on this floor tonight.
rounds.title: POWER USE
options: It rose sharply at midnight.
It fell steadily all night.
It leveled off at ten and then dropped.
rounds.retryLine: Incorrect. Look at midnight.
rounds.thanks: Correct. Somebody switched the vault on at midnight.

rounds.line: One new message from David. Report it accurately.
rounds.clipText: It's David. I'll send the code tomorrow.
options: He said he would send the code the next day.
He said he will send the code yesterday.
He said he had sent the code the day before.
rounds.retryLine: Inaccurate report. Play it again.

rounds.line: Door two. Reported speech required.
rounds.answer: He asked where the key was
alts: He asked me where the key was
rounds.retryLine: Rejected. Statement word order, please.

rounds.line: I can't open it, mate. Rules are rules.
options: If you were to open it, I would sign the log myself.
Open it now or I call your boss.
If you would open it, I will sign.
rounds.retryLine: Nah. Try me again, politely, and get the grammar right.
rounds.thanks: Well… if you sign the log. Go on, then.

radio.name: The Radio
radio.intro: Radio rounds. You speak into the microphone, you catch fast speech, and you never leave dead air.

rounds.line: Mic check. Read the line on the card, nice and clear.
rounds.target: Testing, one, two. This is The Signal.
accept: Testing one two this is the signal
rounds.retryLine: Again, a bit closer to the mic.
rounds.thanks: Levels are good. You sound like radio.

rounds.line: A caller, at full speed. What did they say?
options: What do you want to do?
What did you want to do?
Where do you want to go?
rounds.retryLine: Play it again. Listen to the first word.
rounds.thanks: That's it. Whaddaya equals what do you.

rounds.line: It rained all day. … thousands came.
rounds.note: Choose the link before the air runs out.
options: Even so,
What's more,
To cut a long story short,
rounds.retryLine: Dead air! Pick the contrast.

rounds.line: Give me the headline for tonight.
rounds.target: Never have I seen such a crowd.
rounds.retryLine: Once more. Start with 'Never'.

rounds.line: Last one. Can, or can't?
options: I can't do Thursday.
I can do Thursday.
I could do Thursday.
rounds.retryLine: Listen to the vowel, not the T.
rounds.thanks: Right. A long, strong vowel means can't.

hotel.name: The Hotel
hotel.intro: Hotel rounds. Every option is correct English; choose the one that fits. Cut what should go. Then give the toast against the clock.

rounds.line: The room is… adequate.
options: I'm sorry to hear it falls short. May I ask what would make it more comfortable?
Thank you! We are very proud of our rooms.
Adequate? It's one of the best rooms we've got.
rounds.retryLine: I said adequate. I chose the word with care.

rounds.line: The welcome card. One word is doing no work. Remove it.
rounds.text: We have made advance plans for the gala evening.
rounds.fix: We have made plans for the gala evening.
rounds.retryLine: No. Plans are always made in advance.

rounds.line: And this sentence?
rounds.text: The lobby was small but beautifully lit.
rounds.retryLine: I see nothing wrong with it. Do you?
rounds.thanks: Quite. Not every sentence needs the red pen.

rounds.line: Nine dollars for water. Is it famous water?
rounds.fitNote: Every reply is correct English. Answer in kind, and stay professional.
options: It has a very good agent, sir.
The price list is set by the management.
Yeah, it's a total rip-off, isn't it?
rounds.retryLine: Come on. Give me something to work with.
rounds.thanks: Ha! You should be on stage.

rounds.line: Ms. Whitmore has lost her voice. The toast is yours. Thirty seconds. Put it in order.
parts: Thank you all for coming this weekend.
On Friday a novelist called her room 'adequate', and by Sunday she had put the concierge in her book.
May every one of you leave with a better chapter than you arrived with.
rounds.retryLine: Thank them first. Then the story. Then the wish.
rounds.thanks: Perfect. Now go and say it.

live.name: Live at Nine
live.intro: Broadcast mode: one dead-air meter runs across all three rounds. A good answer buys a little air back.
words: We'll have to leave it there.

rounds.line: We're live. Take the floor.
options: Can I come in here?
Shut up, everyone.
I am agree.
rounds.retryLine: Politely!

rounds.line: Caller on line two.
options: I should have called earlier.
I should call earlier.
I would have called earlier.
rounds.retryLine: Again.

rounds.line: Close the show.
rounds.target: We'll have to leave it there.
rounds.retryLine: Once more.
